steps.label: Paket pruefen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat pz1_aa pz1_ab pz1_ac pz1_ad pz1_ae pz1_af pz1_ag > pz1.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q pz1.tgz)" = 66f44919258c064d8f84df3ffb673e0b ] && rm -rf pz && mkdir pz && tar xzf pz1.tgz -C pz && ls pz/bundle | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render pz/bundle P pz_out1.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > pz_time.txt

steps.label: Ton und Vorschau
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pz_out1.mp4 -i pz/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest ponzi_film1.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i ponzi_film1.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy ponzi_film1_vorschau.mp4 && tar czf pz1v.tgz ponzi_film1_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la ponzi_film1*.mp4 >> pz_time.txt
